subject: Money
title: Wage Stagnation
description: A quick win: understand Wage Stagnation.

hook.text: U.S. median male income in 1973 was $53,000 in today's dollars. In 2023, it was $56,000. Fifty years, 6% growth.

buildup.text: Productivity rose 60% since 1979 but hourly compensation rose only 16%. Where did the rest go?

discovery.text: Corporate profits, executive pay, and shareholder returns absorbed the gains. Workers produce more but earn little more.

twist.text: Combined with rising costs for housing, healthcare, and education, flat wages mean declining living standards.

climax.text: Inflation without matching wage growth is a slow-motion pay cut for an entire generation.

quiz.question: Why has wage stagnation occurred despite rising productivity?
options: Gains went to profits, executives, and shareholders
